about: Behaviour checks for the done judge (assistant/done.go, prompts/assistant/task_done.md). Synthetic cases only. verdicts: what the hub may end with (any one of them passes); delivery: the delivery state it must end with, when delivery is judged. early: decided before any model call.

scenarios.name: research-conclusion
scenarios.title: 查清上传超时原因
scenarios.notes: 查一下为什么大文件上传会超时，给出结论和建议，不用改代码。

replies.text: 查清楚了：网关的请求体超时是 30 秒，大于 200 MB 的文件在慢网络下一定会超时。建议改成分片上传，或者把超时调到 300 秒。日志和复现步骤写在 notes/upload-timeout.md。
